learning_objective: 🧘‍♀️ Learn amazing yoga stretches to start your day with big energy, make your muscles strong, and keep your mind super calm!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Stand tall and strong like a huge mountain! Keep your feet together, stretch your arms up to the sky, and lift your heels to grow as tall as you can.
Sit comfortably and place your hands on your belly. Breathe in deeply through your nose to fill your belly like a big balloon, then breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Sit on the floor, bring the bottoms of your feet together, and hold your toes. Flap your knees up and down gently just like a beautiful butterfly flapping its wings!

fun_activity.title: 🌞 Good Morning Animal Flow
fun_activity.instructions: When you wake up, stretch up high like a Giraffe, bend down low like a Frog, and do a gentle roar like a Lion! Do this every morning to wake up your muscles.

quick_recap: ⭐ The Mountain Pose makes your back straight and helps you grow taller.
⭐ Deep belly breathing is the secret trick to calm your mind when you feel upset.
⭐ Stretching every single day keeps your body flexible and healthy.
